name: Unsigned AppX Installation Attempt Using Add-AppxPackage
description: Detects usage of the "Add-AppxPackage" or it's alias "Add-AppPackage" to install unsigned AppX packages
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Installation of unsigned packages for testing purposes
query: ((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) OR (process.pe.original_file_name:(PowerShell.EXE OR pwsh.dll))) AND (process.command_line:(*Add\-AppPackage\ * OR *Add\-AppxPackage\ *)) AND process.command_line:*\ \-AllowUnsigned*
